      - Emphasize whole, minimally processed foods.
      - Prioritize vegetables (especially leafy greens, cruciferous, and colorful varieties) at every meal.

      - Include legumes and whole grains (quinoa, brown rice, oats, buckwheat).
      - Limit red meat; choose lean poultry or plant proteins.
      - Avoid processed meats, refined grains, and added sugars.
      - Minimize dairy; if included, choose fermented (yogurt, kefir) and lactose-free options.
      - Use herbs and spices (turmeric, ginger, garlic, cinnamon) liberally.
      - Drink water, herbal teas; limit caffeine and avoid alcohol.
      - Consider magnesium-rich foods (pumpkin seeds, spinach, black beans).
